text:
Mira: Heads-up — ACME pilot wants 50ms p95 tail-latency for a private deployment in their VPC. We need cross-team sequencing (product/runtime/infra/security). Quick triage?
Sam (runtime): What's the model, context length, and QPS profile? Also: can they accept quantized variants if needed?
Mira: Model: open-llama-13b, ctx 4k. Traffic: bursty up to ~20 r/s, steady ~4 r/s. Customer insists on quality parity; they're ok with int8 if we validate no regressions.
Jaz (infra): For 13B+4k at 50ms p95 we'll probably need H100-class nodes and prewarmed instances. Autoscale cooldowns and network bandwidth in their VPC matter.
Sam (runtime): Agreed on H100. Runtime plan: continuous batching + KV prefix caching + tight batch latency cap. Need to pin model version and runtime flags: `batch_max_latency_ms`, `kv_cache_enabled`.
Sam (runtime): Example runtime config we're thinking:
```
runtime-config:
  model: open-llama-13b
  quant: int8_opt
  batch_max_latency_ms: 8
  kv_cache_enabled: true
```
Oliver (security): Security checklist: VPC peering or private link, KMS/HSM integration for keys, audit logging, and ATO doc. Key rotation policy + legal signoff required.
Ryan (infra-ops): We can stand up a private cluster in their VPC. Proposal: canary = 2 H100-equivalent instances, prod = 4 (scale plan depends on perf tests). Prewarm_instances=2 for canary. Need infra ticket and IAM plan.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary-ready=false, kms-integration=false, infra-ticket=OPEN-#1234
Mira: Action items — (1) @Sam (runtime): run perf tests + regression eval against ACME prompt set and share numbers by EOD Fri. (2) @Jaz (infra): open infra ticket with H100 capacity request and cost estimate. (3) @Oliver (security): start ATO checklist + KMS onboarding steps. (4) @Ryan: staging cluster + prewarm plan. I'll align with the customer and set expectations. Meeting Thu 10am?
Sam (runtime): I'll run the perf suite: baseline fp16 vs int8_opt. If p95 > 50ms we'll try further quant options or reduce canary context.
Jaz (infra): Created ticket https://jira.redwood/browse/INFRA-4721 — includes H100 capacity request, VPC peering steps, and network egress estimate.
Oliver (security): Drafting ATO in /docs/ato/acme-draft.md and looping in Legal. KMS onboarding checklist started (needs customer KMS endpoint + contact).
Ryan (infra-ops): Staging plan note: `prewarm_instances=2`, `autoscale_min=2`, `autoscale_max=6`, cooldown 60s. Will attach cluster network diagram to the infra ticket.
Mira: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam (runtime): one more thing — we should add a small canary traffic test harness (replay customer traces) to validate tail behavior before canary rollout. I can ship that.
Mira: Yes please — add results to the infra ticket and I'll share with the customer.
Oliver (security): Heads-up: key delivery timeline might be the gating item. If KMS onboarding slips we need to surface fallback (short-lived tokens + audit hooks).
Mira: Noted. I'll surface fallback options to ACME. Meeting invite in a few minutes.
